document.title: Smart AI-Enabled Rapid Feed and Silage Quality Testing System
document.summary: Proposal SIH26111 for Smart India Hackathon 2026 outlining an affordable (INR 1500) plug-and-play feed and silage quality testing device combining custom hardware, computer vision (YOLOv8 & EfficientNet), and a web PWA.

nodes.label: Smart AI-Enabled Rapid Feed and Silage Quality Testing System
nodes.description: Root node for the SIH26111 project proposal report detailing an AI and hardware solution for rapid feed and silage quality testing.
nodes.source_excerpt: Smart AI-Enabled Rapid Feed and Silage Quality Testing System

nodes.label: Proposal Overview & Evaluation
nodes.description: High-level metadata, evaluation criteria, overall ratings, and core value proposition of the proposal.
nodes.source_excerpt: Each problem statement is evaluated on 5 key criteria relevant to your team's strengths and hackathon success.

nodes.label: Evaluation Criteria & Scores
nodes.description: Quantitative evaluation of the project feasibility, hardware affordability, presentation impact, data availability, and win probability.
nodes.source_excerpt: OVERALL SCORE: 4.8 / 5

nodes.label: Unique Selling Proposition (USP)
nodes.description: Key differentiating features of the project including low cost, plug-and-play hardware design, and lab-grade consistency.
nodes.source_excerpt: Complete plug-and-play solution under INR 1500. The custom imaging box ensures lab-grade consistency at field-level cost, producing standardized quality certificates for procurement agencies.

nodes.label: Standardized Quality Certificates
nodes.description: Generated certificates providing lab-grade quality evaluation for feed procurement agencies.
nodes.source_excerpt: producing standardized quality certificates for procurement agencies.

nodes.label: Team Structure & Responsibilities
nodes.description: Six-member team role allocations across Web Development, AI/ML, and Hardware Engineering domains.
nodes.source_excerpt: Role assignments for balanced workload across all 6 members

nodes.label: Web Development Sub-team
nodes.description: Responsible for developing the Farmer Progressive Web App (PWA) and FastAPI backend infrastructure.
nodes.source_excerpt: Farmer PWA with image upload, results, scan history

nodes.label: AI/ML Engineering Sub-team
nodes.description: Responsible for object detection, grading classifiers, model export, and computer vision pipelines.
nodes.source_excerpt: Train YOLOv8 for contaminant detection in feed

nodes.label: Hardware Engineering Sub-team
nodes.description: Responsible for micro-controller firmware, physical inspection box construction, lighting, and sample positioning.
nodes.source_excerpt: ESP32-CAM firmware: auto-capture, WiFi upload, LED ctrl

nodes.label: Hardware System & Bill of Materials
nodes.description: Low-cost physical device components used to capture consistent images under controlled lighting conditions.
nodes.source_excerpt: Hardware Bill of Materials (Total: INR 1,500)

nodes.label: ESP32-CAM (OV2640 2MP)
nodes.description: Microcontroller with integrated camera and Wi-Fi capability for automatic image capture and data transmission.
nodes.source_excerpt: ESP32-CAM (OV2640 2MP): Camera with WiFi for image capture

nodes.label: Custom MDF/Acrylic Inspection Box
nodes.description: Enclosed custom structure designed to eliminate external light interference during image capture.
nodes.source_excerpt: Controlled environment for consistent shots

nodes.label: WS2812B White LED Strip
nodes.description: PWM-controlled LED strips with a light diffuser to ensure uniform, shadowless illumination.
nodes.source_excerpt: Uniform diffused lighting (INR 75 each)

nodes.label: 3D Printed Sample Tray
nodes.description: Standardized physical tray to ensure consistent positioning of feed and silage samples.
nodes.source_excerpt: Standardized sample positioning

nodes.label: Software Stack & Architecture
nodes.description: Full software implementation architecture spanning frontend, backend, computer vision models, and DevOps.
nodes.source_excerpt: Complete data flow from hardware sensors through backend to user-facing applications:

nodes.label: Farmer Progressive Web App (PWA)
nodes.description: React/Next.js and TailwindCSS-based application offering multi-language support (i18n) and offline capabilities.
nodes.source_excerpt: PWA for offline farmer access

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend & Infrastructure
nodes.description: Asynchronous REST API backend powered by Celery tasks, PostgreSQL, and object storage for handling hardware uploads.
nodes.source_excerpt: FastAPI backend, image pipeline, database, auth

nodes.label: FastAPI Application
nodes.description: High-performance Python web framework used to serve API endpoints and process incoming image queues.
nodes.source_excerpt: FastAPI Backend (Image Pipeline)

nodes.label: AI/ML Computer Vision Pipeline
nodes.description: Combined machine learning models for foreign particle detection, quality grading, and ONNX optimized edge runtime.
nodes.source_excerpt: YOLO + EfficientNet (Quality Grading)

nodes.label: YOLOv8 Model
nodes.description: Real-time object detection model trained via Ultralytics and OpenCV to detect foreign contaminants in feed.
nodes.source_excerpt: YOLOv8 (foreign particle detection)

nodes.label: EfficientNet / ResNet-50 Classifier
nodes.description: Deep learning network used to categorize silage and feed quality into standardized A/B/C grades.
nodes.source_excerpt: EfficientNet classifier for A/B/C grading, ONNX export

nodes.label: ONNX Runtime Deployment
nodes.description: Cross-platform model export format utilized for low-latency optimized model execution on edge devices or backend servers.
nodes.source_excerpt: ONNX Runtime (edge deploy)

nodes.label: System Data Flow Architecture
nodes.description: End-to-end data pipeline: sample insertion -> ESP32-CAM capture -> WiFi transfer -> FastAPI backend -> AI evaluation -> PWA report.
nodes.source_excerpt: Complete data flow from hardware sensors through backend to user-facing applications

nodes.label: Datasets & Regulatory Standards
nodes.description: Public, government, and self-collected datasets and domain guidelines used for model training and compliance.
nodes.source_excerpt: Publicly available datasets for training and validating AI/ML models

nodes.label: ICAR & FAO Feed Guidelines
nodes.description: Official quality criteria, composition standards, and grading requirements provided by ICAR India and UN FAO.
nodes.source_excerpt: Quality parameters and grading criteria

nodes.label: Multi-Source Training Dataset Collection
nodes.description: Aggregated dataset consisting of ImageNet subset, Kaggle grain datasets, and 200-500 self-collected custom images per class.
nodes.source_excerpt: Custom Training Data: 200-500 images per class from HW box

nodes.label: Implementation Roadmap & Risk Management
nodes.description: 8-day development timeline and operational risk identification paired with pragmatic mitigation strategies.
nodes.source_excerpt: Sprint plan from today until the presentation

nodes.label: 8-Day Sprint Implementation Timeline
nodes.description: Sequential sprint strategy covering setup (Days 1-2), training/web (Days 3-5), integration (Days 6-7), and demo (Day 8).
nodes.source_excerpt: Sprint plan from today until the presentation

nodes.label: Risk Mitigation Strategies
nodes.description: Methods to solve lighting variations (box enclosure), small datasets (data augmentation), and digital literacy (one-button UI).
nodes.source_excerpt: Controlled lighting inside custom hardware box; Data augmentation + transfer learning; One-button capture, voice-guided instructions

nodes.label: Presentation & Pitching Strategy
nodes.description: Structured plan for high-impact hackathon presentation, live hardware demo, and slide outline.
nodes.source_excerpt: Live demo the hardware prototype (judges love tangible solutions)

nodes.label: Live Prototype Demo & Key Pitch Phrases
nodes.description: Tactical pitch structure highlighting tangible hardware, offline-first operation, INR 1500 cost, and >90% accuracy.
nodes.source_excerpt: Total prototype cost is just INR 1,500 -- deployable at scale
